title: Dark laptop orbit to phone list, wordmark close
summary: A dark laptop with a market dashboard: the camera swoops from a wide 3/4 view into the charts, pulls back, drops to a phone with an earnings list, glides down it under a rim glint, then a lit wordmark holds.
use_when: A finance or analytics product with a desktop dashboard and a mobile companion
Showing the same product on two devices in one continuous camera move
A silent, premium dark teaser of 10 to 15 s
You have two screenshots and a wordmark, no copy lines

look.type_style: wordmark only: bold grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, about 5 % of frame height; UI type is the product's own small sans

sfx.event: camera swoop into the laptop and the drop to the phone
rim glint passes the phone edge

structure.shot: dark closed-room laptop in 3/4 view, screen shows a table of tickers above two charts; soft curved light band at left
structure.camera: orbit + push-in: laptop width about 27 % to 70 % of frame in 30 fr, yaw swings toward frontal, roll about -9 deg/s
structure.motion: camera only, easings.inExpo into the screen (±0.25 s); UI static

structure.shot: low close angle on the screen: line chart left, red-to-green area chart right, keyboard foreground
structure.camera: orbit at keyboard height, push-in about 1.00 to 1.15, then lateral truck left about 14 px/fr @1920 (419 px/s at 2-3 s)
structure.motion: camera only, easings.inOutSine (±0.25 s); charts already drawn, no draw-on visible

structure.shot: camera drops to keyboard level, area chart fills the right two thirds, line chart cropped at left
structure.camera: dolly down then slow drift right and up about 1.5 px/fr, scale about 1.00 to 0.98

structure.shot: pull back to the whole laptop, frontal and centred, small in a black void; full dashboard readable as a layout
structure.camera: pull-out: laptop width about 100 % to 36 % of frame in 15 fr (4.00-4.50), then hold with drift 1.00 to 1.04
structure.motion: springs.cameraOut, about 15 fr (±0.25 s), no overshoot

structure.shot: laptop slides out downward, a phone enters frontal: dated list of tickers with status tags in green and red, groups with a more-count
structure.camera: vertical slide 175 px/s @1920 between devices, then push-in 1.00 to 1.08 on the phone
structure.motion: phone settles springs.heavy about 24 fr (overshoot not measurable); list static

structure.shot: phone tilts back into steep perspective, close on the list rows; a white rim glint runs along the right edge; ends on a short pull back
structure.camera: push-in to about 1.8, then dolly up the list 290 px/s @1920 (8-9 s, content scrolls up), slow zoom out 6 %/s, quick pull-out at 10.00
structure.motion: camera easings.inOutSine; tilt about 0 to 35 deg over 15 fr (±0.25 s); glint glow follows the edge

structure.shot: wordmark centred on black, a soft grey light arc sweeps down from the top right corner behind it
structure.camera: static frame; the light arc grows and swings from corner to a diagonal band over 1.75 s
structure.motion: wordmark light-on from grey to white over about 22 fr (10.27-11.00), holds 60 fr, dims to grey from 12.77 (±0.25 s); arc easings.inOutSine

params.desktopScreen: laptop screenshot, dashboard with a data table over two charts (authored at 1512x982)
params.phoneScreen: phone screenshot, a long vertical list that can be glided through
params.wordmark: product name shown as the end wordmark

notes: Zero cuts: one continuous camera move, rows split at camera state changes from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). Silent reference; sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Palette from palettegen on kf 1.5/6.5/9.5/11.5; the chart green and red accents are below the 6-colour cut. Proposed term: rim-glint (white highlight sliding along a device edge, rows 6). Device switch (5.75-6.00) is a vertical camera slide, not a cut.
